AUTHORED_SOURCE.text: Promptly after the Agreement Date, subject to the other provisions of this Section 4.6, the Company shall, shall cause its Subsidiaries and its and their respective directors and officers to, and shall instruct and use its reasonable best efforts to cause the other Company Representatives to, cease and cause to be terminated, and not authorize or knowingly permit to continue, any discussions or negotiations with any Person (other than Parent and Merger Sub), or any representative thereof, conducted prior to the date of this Agreement with respect to an Acquisition Proposal or any Acquisition Inquiry, terminate “data room” access to such Persons, and request the prompt return or destruction of all confidential information previously furnished to any Person within the last six months for the purposes of evaluating a possible Acquisition Proposal and any documents and other materials containing such information.
